title: Regulatory Compliance Note on Medicated Rations Under the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
A medicated ration is run only under a veterinary feed directive that is current on the day the mix is run. A directive is current for the programme's validity period in calendar days from the day the veterinarian wrote it, and the mill takes the date from the directive itself rather than from the member's recollection of when the veterinarian was out.

## When a directive lapses

Where a directive expires the programme is suspended for medicated rations at once, and where the programme carries an expiry grace a load already ordered before the expiry may still be run inside that grace. Suspension stops the medicated formula and does not stop unmedicated loads on other programmes. The programme resumes only when a current directive is filed and recorded.

## Withdrawal periods

Withdrawal periods are tracked for the member on programmes within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes that carry that service, and on programmes that do not, the member is told plainly that the responsibility for observing the withdrawal is theirs.

## The authority the mill acts on

Whether a current directive stands is read from the mill's own records before any medicated ration is run or any change of standing is recorded: the record of a current directive against the programme, the programme number under which the programme is held, and the directive the ration is to run under as it is carried on the order. A member who asks the mill to run a medicated formula without a directive is refused, and no circumstance at the desk changes that.

## Points of judgement

| The position on the day the mix is run | How it reads |
| --- | --- |
| A directive within its validity period stands recorded against the programme | The medicated ration may be run |
| The directive has passed its validity period | The programme is suspended for medicated rations at once |
| The directive has passed its validity period, the programme carries an expiry grace, and the load was ordered before the expiry | That load may still be run inside the grace |
| No directive at all is recorded | The medicated formula is not run, whatever the circumstances at the desk |

*Hypothetical.* A directive is dated by the veterinarian who wrote it, and the programme's validity period is counted in calendar days from that date. A mix run on the final day of that period is run under a current directive; a mix run on the day after it is not, whatever date the member recalls the veterinarian being out on the farm.
